description: 33kV Circuit Live Operational Data is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our 33kV Circuit Live Operational Data dataset provides information on the current flowing through each of our 33kV feeders. The dataset provides half-hourly data in a 30‑day window. Related Feature Pages Operational Dashboard - Our Operational Data page provides information on the various operational datasets we host on our Portal. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Extra High Voltage (EHV), Circuit, Live Data, EHV Substation Data. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
